description: Output quality eval: verify ue-execution-trace produces step-by-step execution chains with node types and cross-BP connections

cases._precondition_rationale: Issues #19514 and #25527: the llm_judge below strictly requires a real step-by-step trace, so it may only run where B_Hero_Default genuinely exists. The canonical Lyra 5.7 fixture was verified to expose an event-root graph with reachable depth 8; declare it present via EVAL_PROJECT_ASSETS/--project-assets or SKIP (never a project-version false-red, and a SKIP can't mask a real trace failure — no-mask #14675).

assertions.description: Should use ue_trace_execution for Blueprint flow tracing
Should show execution chain with steps or nodes

assertions.criteria: Does the response show a step-by-step execution chain for B_Hero_Default with numbered steps or nodes? It should trace the flow from an event entry point through downstream calls.
assertions.description: Should provide sequential execution flow (LLM judge)

cases._precondition_rationale: Issue #19514: gated so an absent GA_Weapon_Fire SKIPs rather than 'lenient-passing' on a non-existent asset (a subtle no-mask violation #14675 — a pass here would falsely imply the ability flow traces). Runs where the asset is declared present.

assertions.description: Should use ue_trace_execution for ability flow tracing

cases._precondition_rationale: Issue #19514: same strict-judge shape as QUAL-01 — the llm_judge requires a real input-to-action chain, so it only runs where IA_Jump exists; otherwise SKIP (no project-version false-red).

assertions.description: Should use ue_trace_execution for input chain tracing
Should reference input action and mapping context

assertions.criteria: Does the response trace the chain from input action (IA_Jump) through the input mapping context to the actual gameplay action (e.g., character jump)?
assertions.description: Should show complete input-to-action chain (LLM judge)
